waypoints.name: Cutthroat Peak Climbers Trail Pullout (Hwy 20, ~1.5 mi W of Washington Pass)
waypoints.note: Roadside pullout on north side of SR-20; climbers trail leaves east end, crosses State Creek to basin below Cutthroat Peak.
waypoints.directions: Park in the long pullout on the north side of Highway 20 about 1.5 miles west of Washington Pass, at roughly 4,950 feet. The climbers' trail leaves the east end of the pullout and crosses State Creek into the basin below Cutthroat Peak — the same start used for the South Buttress route, so once you're up in the boulder field bear right and north toward the North Ridge Notch rather than left toward the South Buttress gully.
